title: Towards Responsible and Fair Data Science: Resource Allocation for Inclusive and Sustainable Analytics

bias_targets.methodology: Proposing a quantitative Fairness Index (FI) that incorporates server location, data provenance, and data sovereignty to counteract Western-centric/Global North dominance and ensure equitable participation of the Global South in data science resource allocation.

Developing multi-dimensional fairness metrics and proposing fair data preparation strategies to ensure overlapping demographic attributes are adequately represented and balanced across inputs, content, algorithms, and hardware infrastructure.
